review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that schools should reward students with the best results in academic performance, whereas others concur students who gradually improve are more desirable. Personally, I agree that both those kind of students should be rewarded.

Admittedly, it is fundamental that school should reward the out-performing students. Students, who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, deserve their praises and privileges. Hence, this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, propeling them towards overall academic improvements. Moreover, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life where only the most astonishing individuals are rewarded. As a consequent, students are used to this reality and continue to thrive in the face of fierce competition, which eventually enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, students with improving academic performance should also received incentive rewards from school. Since only a few smart students can come first and achieve the rewards, it causes others to think that their effort is futile being unable to surpass those outstanding individuals makes students prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually losing the incentive to study. Thus, emphasizing improvement not only encourages students to be diligent in their studies but also helps student to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. Furthermore, students would have the constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all other.
In conclusion, although talented students are believed to receive academic rewards, it is undoubtedly important to incentivize students who perform better at school.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận trên nguồn ảnh đủ trang.

review.overall: Em hoàn thành bốn phần, nêu rõ nên thưởng cả học sinh đạt kết quả cao lẫn học sinh tiến bộ. Body 1 có hai nhánh công sức và cạnh tranh; Body 2 có nguyên nhân em khác nản và tác dụng tự cải thiện. Tuy nhiên, câu 'it causes others to think ... futile being unable ...' ghép hai quan hệ mà thiếu dấu ngắt; 'students ... which eventually enable' và 'student to understand' còn sai hòa hợp. Bài cho thấy em nắm dàn ý nhưng tự soát cấu trúc chưa chắc. Em cần tách chuỗi lập luận Body 2 và rà từng mệnh đề trước khi viết lại. Body 1 có “Moreover” để vào lý do cạnh tranh nhưng chưa giới thiệu lý do công sức. Body 2 cũng chưa báo lý do đầu; “Thus” trước “emphasizing improvement” trình bày lý do thứ hai như một hệ quả của ý nản chí. “Furthermore” ở câu cuối chỉ tiếp tục ý tự cải thiện, không sửa được ranh giới này.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
